meta_title: PCOS Is Now PMOS: A UK Guide to Eating Well With It
meta_description: PCOS was officially renamed PMOS in 2026. This UK guide explains what changed and the dietitian backed food advice that eases insulin resistance and symptoms.
ai_summary: In May 2026, PCOS was officially renamed PMOS, Polyendocrine Metabolic Ovarian Syndrome, after a global consensus published in The Lancet. This guide explains why the name changed, why insulin resistance sits at the centre of the condition for up to 80 percent of those affected, and the UK dietitian backed food approach that helps: low GI carbohydrates, regular balanced meals, protein and fibre at every meal, and a realistic 5 percent weight loss goal rather than restrictive dieting. It also covers the evidence on myo inositol and other supplements, and answers common questions about managing symptoms through diet.
